description: This file implements timestamp formatting functions for the tr2_tbuf structure, using gettimeofday and time conversion functions to generate local and UTC datetime strings with microsecond precision.

methods.name: void tr2_tbuf_local_time(struct tr2_tbuf * tb)
methods.description: Formats the current local time with millisecond precision into the buffer of a tr2_tbuf structure.

methods.name: void tr2_tbuf_utc_datetime_extended(struct tr2_tbuf * tb)
methods.description: Formats the current UTC time in extended ISO 8601 format with microsecond precision into the buffer of a tr2_tbuf structure.

methods.name: void tr2_tbuf_utc_datetime(struct tr2_tbuf * tb)
methods.description: Formats the current UTC date and time in compact ISO 8601 format with microsecond precision into the buffer of a tr2_tbuf structure.
